items.name: scheduler
items.title: Scheduler engine
items.description: Drag-and-drop month/week/day scheduler with recurrence, resource lanes and free-slot search. Zero dependencies.

items.name: sounds
items.title: goodui sounds
items.description: 24 synthesized UI sounds with no audio files (tap, toggle, success, error, notify, celebrate…): Web Audio recipes, play(), useSound(), <SoundProvider> and data-sound attributes. Off until the visitor opts in.

items.name: goodui-motion
items.title: goodui motion and material tokens
items.description: The shared spring set, easing curves, elevation shadows, press behaviour and grain every goodui component uses. Installed automatically with any component that needs it.

items.name: locale
items.title: goodui locale
items.description: Set the language once and every goodui component speaks it: <GooduiLocaleProvider lang labels>, useGooduiLocale() with Intl number, date, relative and currency formatters, useLabels() and RTL direction. English and en-US without it.

items.name: scheduler-week
items.title: Week scheduler
items.description: Drag-and-drop week calendar with resize, drag-to-create and recurring events.

items.name: resource-timeline
items.title: Resource timeline
items.description: Staff or rooms as rows on a day timeline with drag, resize, conflicts and click-to-book. FullCalendar charges $480 for this view. Here it is free.

items.name: slot-picker
items.title: Slot picker
items.description: Calendly-style date and time slot picker with availability and time zone.

items.name: today-schedule
items.title: Today's schedule
items.description: Dashboard card with the next appointments and a live progress line.

items.name: kpi-cards
items.title: KPI cards
items.description: Four metric cards with trend badges and comparison to last period.

items.name: notification-settings
items.title: Notification settings
items.description: Per-channel notification preferences grouped by topic.

items.name: sign-in-split
items.title: Split sign-in
items.description: Brand-forward sign-in with a live product mock, rotating testimonials, social login and polished error, reset and success states.

items.name: otp-verify
items.title: OTP verification
items.description: 6-digit email code screen that submits by itself, shakes on a wrong code, counts down to resend and lets users change their email.

items.name: setup-checklist
items.title: Setup checklist
items.description: Getting-started card with a progress ring, expandable one-click steps, skip and undo, and a confetti finish that gets new accounts to their first booking.

items.name: empty-states
items.title: Empty states
items.description: Four illustrated empty states (no bookings, no results, offline, no access), each with a primary action that works.

items.name: contacts-directory
items.title: Contacts directory
items.description: Client directory with search, A–Z jump rail, favorites, grid and list views, and a detail sheet with editable tags and notes.

items.name: usage-meters
items.title: Usage meters
items.description: Gauges for bookings, SMS credits, seats and storage that warn near the limit, forecast usage and top up through a live-priced dialog.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: Color-coded team timeline of bookings, payments, notes, status changes and uploads, with type filters and load more.

items.name: whats-new
items.title: What's new
items.description: Changelog launcher with an unread badge that opens illustrated release slides and a full changelog view.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt composer
items.description: Rich prompt input with slash commands, file attachments, model picker, token counter and a history of sent prompts.

items.name: profile-settings
items.title: Profile settings
items.description: Cover-art profile card with avatar upload, live handle availability check, time zone and locale pickers with a format preview, and a sticky unsaved-changes bar.

items.name: localization-settings
items.title: Localization settings
items.description: Languages table with completion bars, publish and default controls, auto-translate progress, an add-language dialog and a booking-page preview that flips to RTL.

items.name: password-reset
items.title: Password reset
items.description: Three-step reset flow on one card: request by email, 6-digit code with resend cooldown, then a new password with live rules, ending on an animated success.

items.name: magic-link-sent
items.title: Magic link sent
items.description: Check-your-inbox screen with an animated envelope, one-click mail app buttons, a resend countdown ring, inline email edit, expiry timer and a code fallback.

items.name: usage-alerts
items.title: Usage alerts
items.description: Metered usage bars with forecast overlays and threshold markers, alert rules with channels and toggles, a new-rule dialog and a simulate-a-day button that fires alerts.

items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity heatmap
items.description: GitHub-style calendar heatmap of a year of bookings with tooltips, bookings or revenue metric, 12-month or 90-day range, streak cards, best hours bars and best weekdays.

items.name: approvals-queue
items.title: Approvals queue
items.description: Approval inbox for time off, refunds, discounts and schedule changes with approve, reject with a required reason, j/k/a/r keyboard navigation, a done tab and undo.

items.name: page-header-actions
items.title: Page header actions
items.description: Page header patterns in one scrolling page: breadcrumb, avatar, inline rename, status badge, primary and overflow actions, tabs with counts, filter chips, a delete confirmation, and a sticky header that compacts on scroll.

items.name: day-agenda
items.title: Day agenda
items.description: Timeline agenda with a moving current-time line, now/next cards, overlapping bookings packed into columns, and drag-to-resize that snaps to 15 minutes (Shift+arrows on the keyboard).

items.name: waitlist-manager
items.title: Waitlist manager
items.description: Waitlist with priority reordering, open slots to offer, a 15-minute countdown on each offer, simulated accept/decline, auto-release of expired offers and a next-up card.

items.name: hero-product-shot
items.title: Hero with product shot
items.description: Centered hero over a dot grid with a tilting, parallax product mock that goes live on click (numbers roll, chart grows, floating booking toast), avatar trust row and a trial dialog with email validation and an inbox success state.

items.name: logo-cloud-marquee
items.title: Logo cloud marquee
items.description: Two opposing marquee rows of hand-drawn customer marks with edge fades, pause on hover, a play/pause control and tappable logos that reveal who the customer is.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ accordion
items.description: Height-animated FAQ with a sticky sidebar of topic filters with counts, search that highlights matches inside questions, expand/collapse all and an ask-a-question fallback for empty results.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats band with counting numbers
items.description: Four big counting statistics in a split card; hovering or focusing a stat draws its yearly sparkline and updates a live caption, with a replay button.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: Split newsletter card with topic checkboxes, validation, a counting reader number, a success check with the chosen topics and a sidebar of recent issues you can open.

items.name: import-progress
items.title: Import progress
items.description: Live CSV import screen with a rolling row counter, striped progress, stage checklist, just-imported feed, auto-fixed warnings with a CSV report download, pause/resume and a cancel confirmation.

items.name: order-tracking
items.title: Order tracking
items.description: Parcel tracking with a route map whose truck moves along the path as scans arrive, a timeline of stages, copyable tracking number, text-me-updates dialog, receipt download and a simulate button.

items.name: client-profile
items.title: Client profile
items.description: Cover-art client card with lifetime value, visits and copyable contact details, editable tags, a monthly spend chart, next-visit card, visit timeline with ratings, team notes with undo and copyable color formulas, plus book and SMS actions.

items.name: gift-card-issue
items.title: Gift card issue
items.description: Amount chips or custom amount, five card designs, occasion tags, recipient and delivery fields with validation, and a live 3D-flipping gift card preview that reveals the redeem code once issued, with copy, save and resend.

items.name: consent-form
items.title: Consent form with signature
items.description: Scroll-to-read consent document with a reading progress meter that unlocks the required statements, typed legal name, a draw-to-sign canvas with clear, validation and a signed-and-sealed state with a downloadable copy.

items.name: prompt-library
items.title: Prompt library
items.description: Folder sidebar with counts and a starred filter, searchable prompt cards with highlighted {{variables}}, tags, versions and usage, a use dialog that fills variables into a live preview with copy and send, plus new prompt and delete with undo.

items.name: fine-tune-jobs
items.title: Fine-tune job list
items.description: Job list with status filters, live training progress and loss sparklines, a detail panel with an animated loss curve, metadata, deploy-to-assistant, cancel with confirmation, retry for failures and a log console, plus a new-job dialog with a cost estimate.

items.name: schema-browser
items.title: Schema browser
items.description: Searchable schema and table tree beside a table page with row counts, related-table chips, column list with primary and foreign keys that navigate, sample rows and generated DDL, each copyable.

items.name: export-center
items.title: Export center
items.description: Export jobs with format icons, animated progress, ready downloads that really save a file, failed and expired states with retry, delete with undo, scheduled exports with toggles and a new-export dialog with source, range, format and column picking.

items.name: number-flow
items.title: Number flow
items.description: Digits roll to the new value with locale formatting, prefixes and suffixes.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer button
items.description: A light sweep runs across the button. Pure CSS; the sweep is removed for reduced motion.

items.name: tabs-indicator
items.title: Tabs indicator
items.description: Tabs whose indicator glides between tabs on a shared-layout spring (underline with hover highlight, pill, or segmented with icons), with arrow-key navigation and panels that slide in the direction of travel while the height eases to fit.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: iOS-style segmented control whose thumb springs to the chosen segment and squeezes while pressed, with sizes, icons, full-width mode, dividers that hide next to the thumb, and radio-group arrow keys.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Horizontal or vertical stepper where the connecting line fills between steps, numbers morph into drawn checkmarks, a current-step ring glides to the active step, errors shake, and completed steps are clickable.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS-style dock whose tiles magnify on a spring as the pointer nears, with tooltips, running dots, badges and a launch bounce, falling back to a simple press scale on touch.

items.name: bottom-nav
items.title: Bottom navigation
items.description: Mobile bottom bar where a pill glides to the selected tab and its icon bounces, in a labelled or expanding variant, with popping badges and an optional raised center action.

items.name: command-palette-morph
items.title: Command palette morph
items.description: A search field morphs into a command palette through a shared layout animation, with fuzzy matching, highlighted letters, grouped results, a sliding selection, arrow keys, Enter, Esc and Ctrl/Cmd+K.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing dialog
items.description: A service card expands into a booking dialog, with its image, title and price flying into place through a shared-layout spring, then folds back into the card on Esc or backdrop click.

items.name: drawer-spring
items.title: Spring drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet with half and full snap points plus side drawers on a spring; drag the handle and the release speed picks the snap point or closes it, while the backdrop fades with the drag.

items.name: popover-morph
items.title: Popover morph
items.description: A small button such as "Add note" morphs into a floating form panel, its label sliding into the header, and shrinks back into the button on save, Esc or an outside click.

items.name: tooltip-animated
items.title: Animated tooltip
items.description: A tooltip springs out of the trigger's side and can lean toward the pointer over avatars; tooltips in a delay group open instantly once one is already showing.

items.name: dropdown-stagger
items.title: Stagger dropdown
items.description: A dropdown menu springs open while its items stagger in, with a highlight that glides between items, submenus, checkbox and radio items, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: accordion-height
items.title: Accordion height
items.description: Accordion whose panels spring open to their real height (motion height:auto) with a rotating chevron, in single or multiple mode, with arrow-key, Home and End navigation between headers.

items.name: list-reorder
items.title: List reorder
items.description: Drag-to-reorder list with a grip handle, a lifted shadow on the dragged row, neighbours that spring into place, and Alt+Arrow keyboard moves announced to screen readers.

items.name: table-row-presence
items.title: Table row presence
items.description: Data table where new rows grow in with a brief highlight, removed rows slide out and collapse, and re-sorting glides every row to its new position.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated list
items.description: Notification stack where new items spring in from the top, older ones glide down, slightly dimmed in the depth variant, and items beyond the limit blur away.

items.name: tree-expand
items.title: Tree expand
items.description: File or category tree with spring expand/collapse, indentation guides, a selection highlight that glides between rows, and full arrow-key, Enter and type-ahead navigation.

items.name: expandable-row-list
items.title: Expandable row list
items.description: Appointment rows that open inline into a raised card with notes and working actions, while neighbouring rows smoothly make room.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Chips input where Enter, comma or paste adds tags that spring in, Backspace arms then removes, duplicates shake, with a filtered suggestions dropdown, validation and a max count.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: One-time code input from plain inputs with auto-advance, paste and SMS autofill, a blinking caret and popping digits, then a pulsing verify, green success bounce or red shake.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating label input
items.description: Input and textarea whose label springs up on focus or value, with prefix/suffix slots that fade in, an animated clear button, character counter and a slide-in error.

items.name: vanish-input
items.title: Vanish input
items.description: Search field with rotating, blurred-in placeholder hints; on submit the typed text dissolves into drifting particles drawn on a canvas.

items.name: input-shake
items.title: Input shake
items.description: Validation wrapper for any input that shakes and slides in an error with an icon when invalid, and draws a check circle when valid.

items.name: switch-spring
items.title: Spring switch
items.description: Switch with a springy thumb that squashes while pressed, icons that spin inside the thumb, three sizes, label and description.

items.name: checkbox-draw
items.title: Drawn checkbox
items.description: Checkbox whose check stroke draws itself in over a popping fill, with an indeterminate dash and an animated strike-through for checklists.

items.name: slider-tooltip
items.title: Slider with tooltip
items.description: Single or range slider built from scratch with pointer and keyboard control, step snapping, marks and a value bubble that scales in while dragging.

items.name: search-expand
items.title: Expanding search
items.description: Search icon that springs open into a field with a recent-searches dropdown and a / shortcut; Esc or blur folds it back when empty.

items.name: file-drop-pulse
items.title: File drop zone
items.description: Drag-and-drop zone whose border pulses while files hover, then lists files with type icons, springy progress bars, size and type errors, and undo on remove.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple button
items.description: Material-style ink ripple that grows from the exact press point and fades on release, pure CSS, across five variants and icon buttons.

items.name: rainbow-button
items.title: Rainbow button
items.description: Button with a seamlessly flowing rainbow border and a soft colored glow underneath, tuned to invert cleanly between light and dark themes.

items.name: border-beam-button
items.title: Border beam button
items.description: A short light beam rides around the button's rounded border with CSS offset-path, with a conic fallback and a static gradient for reduced motion.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic button
items.description: Button and its label are pulled toward a nearby cursor with a smooth falloff and spring back on leave; off for touch and reduced motion.

items.name: stateful-button
items.title: Stateful button
items.description: Async button that morphs idle to spinner to drawn check or shaking error, with a spring width change between labels.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copy-to-clipboard button whose icon blurs from copy into a drawn check with a popping Copied! tooltip, plus a fallback when the Clipboard API is blocked.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Press-and-hold button for destructive actions: a fill sweeps across with the label flipping color at its edge, early release rewinds it, works with Space and Enter.

items.name: liquid-glass-button
items.title: Liquid glass button
items.description: Frosted glass button and pill toolbar with backdrop blur, rim light and a specular highlight that follows the pointer, falling back to a solid tint without backdrop-filter.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: Light/dark toggle that reveals the new theme as a circle from the click point with the View Transitions API while the sun morphs into a moon.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: Reveals a heading word by word or letter by letter with a staggered blur, fade and rise when it scrolls into view or on demand.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of phrases with a human rhythm and a caret that only blinks while idle; works as an animated input placeholder.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word rotate
items.description: Swaps words in place with a vertical slide and blur while the box springs to each word's width, so the sentence glides instead of jumping.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny text
items.description: A soft light band sweeps across muted text on a loop or on hover, made for badges like "New: AI receptionist". Pure CSS.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient text
items.description: Text filled with a slowly drifting multi-stop gradient, with Aurora, Sunset, Ocean and theme palettes tuned separately for light and dark.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble text
items.description: Text scrambles through random glyphs and resolves left to right on mount, on view, on hover or on demand; renders the real text on the server.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: Draws a marker highlight, hand-drawn underline, circle, box or strike-through behind a phrase when it scrolls into view, in six colors.

items.name: text-morph
items.title: Text morph
items.description: Morphs between strings letter by letter: shared characters spring to their new positions while the rest blur in and out.

items.name: scroll-velocity
items.title: Scroll velocity
items.description: Rows of large text drift in opposite directions and speed up or flip with your scroll speed and direction.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight card
items.description: A soft spotlight and a lit border follow the pointer across a card; in a group, neighboring cards' borders light up too.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt card
items.description: Tilts toward the pointer on a spring with a moving glare, a shifting shadow and layers that float at their own depth.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border beam
items.description: Wraps any card or input and runs a light beam around its border, matching the element's corner radius automatically.

items.name: glow-border
items.title: Glow border
items.description: A slowly rotating gradient arc travels around the card border with a soft glow that intensifies on hover and focus.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive blur
items.description: Blur that grows stronger toward the edge of a scroll container, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers; shown on a scrolling bookings list.

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable card
items.description: A card expands in place on a spring to reveal details, such as a staff profile with bookable slots or a plan's full feature list.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot grid
items.description: A dot or line grid background with a radial, top or edge fade and an optional glow that follows the pointer. Pure CSS.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering grid
items.description: A canvas grid of small squares that flicker in opacity, follows the theme color, is sharp on retina and pauses off-screen.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Soft colored light drifts slowly behind a section, with light and dark palettes and only transform animations for low CPU.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: Canvas particles drift gently, link up with fine lines and move out of the pointer's way; density scales with the area.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endless horizontal or vertical marquee with faded edges that pauses on hover, shown with customer logos, testimonials and a live bookings ticker.

items.name: counter-up
items.title: Counter up
items.description: Counts from 0 (or from) to the value with an ease-out curve when it scrolls into view, with locale formatting, once or replay-on-return, and counts from the current value when it changes.

items.name: meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Labeled usage meter like "SMS credits 7,420 / 10,000" whose fill springs to the new value and shifts to amber and rose near the limit, with optional per-seat segments.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear progress in four variants: spring-filled determinate, indeterminate double sweep, moving stripes and segmented steps.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular progress
items.description: SVG ring or 270° gauge whose arc springs to the value via stroke-dashoffset, with a rolling percentage or custom label in the center.

items.name: sparkline-draw
items.title: Sparkline draw
items.description: Smooth monotone sparkline that draws itself in, fades in a gradient area, shows point values on hover or arrow keys, and redraws when the data changes.

items.name: delta-badge
items.title: Delta badge
items.description: "+12.4%" change badge whose digits roll, arrow rotates to the new direction and background pulses green or red, with an inverted mode for metrics where down is good.

items.name: cell-flash
items.title: Cell flash
items.description: Wraps a table value and briefly flashes it green when it rises, red when it falls, with a fading ▲/▼, like a trading terminal.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast stack
items.description: Self-contained toaster with toast() API: cards stack and expand on hover, swipe away with a drag, morph from loading to success or error for promises, and pause their timers on hover.

items.name: notification-badge
items.title: Notification badge
items.description: Count badge for icon buttons that springs in, bumps when the count rises, rolls its digits, caps at 99+ and offers a pulse ring or dot variant.

items.name: skeleton-auto
items.title: Skeleton auto
items.description: SkeletonSwap traces its children's text lines, controls and avatars ( or data-skeleton elements) into shimmer blocks with one shared sweep, then cross-fades to the real content; includes line, circle and block primitives.

items.name: spinners
items.title: Spinners
items.description: Six CSS-only loaders (ring, dots, bars, pulse, orbit, typing) sized in px or presets and painted with currentColor.

items.name: multi-step-loader
items.title: Multi-step loader
items.description: Card or overlay that ticks through steps like "Reserving slot…" with spinners, drawn checkmarks and a filling rail, ending on an animated success state.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: Hand-written canvas 2D confetti with flipping paper physics, fired over the page from an element or inside a contained canvas via ref, and a no-op under reduced motion.

items.name: success-check
items.title: Success check
items.description: Check or X in a circle that draws its stroke, fills, then pops with a ray-and-ring burst, for payment and booking result screens.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: One button with ten variants, six tones, seven shadows, ten animations, three shapes and five sizes that all combine, plus loading and icon slots.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: One badge, every layer: solid, soft, outline, status dot, gradient, glass and neo in six tones, with pulse, shine, bounce-in and count-pop animations, icons, removable chips and clickable filters.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Eight surfaces (elevated, glass, gradient border, neo, inset…) with shadow, padding, radius and accent stripes, plus hover layers (lift, 3D tilt, pointer spotlight, glow, scale) and a looping border beam.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Six field styles with top, floating, inline or hidden labels, focus ring, glow, underline-grow or lift, error shake with sliding messages, icon and text addons, clear button, counter and auto-growing textarea.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Six sizes and four shapes including squircle, status dots with pulse, solid, gradient and rotating story rings, image fade-in with name-based gradient initials, and groups that cap with +N and fan out on hover.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Soft, solid, outline, left-accent, glass, neo and full-width banner alerts with tone-picked icons, actions, slide, fade, shake or pop entrances, smooth collapse on dismiss and a pausable auto-dismiss countdown.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Six variants (underline, pill, segmented, enclosed folder tabs, soft, vertical line), a sliding, fading or static indicator, fade or directional slide panels, tones, sizes, shapes, shadows and orientation, with icons, count badges, arrow keys and a one-line items API.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: iOS, Material 3, square, neo-brutalist, icon thumb and ON/OFF label variants with none, smooth, spring and bounce motion, six tones, three sizes, track shadows, sun/moon or check/x glyphs, label and description on either side, and a loading state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox & Radio
items.description: Checkbox and RadioGroup on real inputs with default, filled, outline, circle, neo and whole-card variants, draw, pop and bounce animations, tones, sizes, shadows, indeterminate, invalid and descriptions.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Line, dashed, dotted, gradient, double, glow and ornament separators with diamond, dot or icon marks, labels at the center, start or end, tones, thickness, vertical orientation, a draw-in-on-view and a shimmer animation.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Slash, chevron, dot, pill, arrow-step and underline trails with four current-page styles, tones, sizes, a staggered fade or sliding hover underline, and long trails that collapse into a keyboard-friendly menu.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Outline, soft, ghost, pill, neo, minimal and carousel-dot pagination with a sliding active marker or press feedback, tones, sizes and shapes, plus first/last, range info, page-size select and jump-to-page.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Layered heading: semantic level and size decoupled, sans/serif/mono/display font slots you map to your own fonts, eight ink treatments (gradient, muted tail, outline, marker highlight, hand-drawn squiggle, shimmer…), serif-italic emphasis via _words_, and on-view word, letter and mask reveals.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Every body-copy role in one primitive: paragraph, lead, small, caption, overline, eyebrow pill, quote with attribution and inline code, with tones, readable measures, truncate or line clamp, and on-view entrances.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline link with seven underline styles (static, slide-in, grow from center, marker sweep, nudging arrow), line decorations, tones, leading icons and automatic external-link handling. Works with next/link via as.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard keys and combos in flat, raised 3D, outline, glass, neo and solid styles. Keycaps depress when the real keys are pressed, Mod maps to ⌘ or Ctrl, and onTrigger turns any combo or G-then-T sequence into a working hotkey.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: KPI card with seven variants, tones, shadows and sizes: count-up or rolling NumberFlow values, auto-toned delta badges (invertible for no-show rates), line, area or bar sparklines that draw in, icons, footers and a skeleton state.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Fully custom single or multi select: outline, filled, ghost, underline, pill and neo triggers; icons, avatars, descriptions and groups; search with match highlight, chips, clear, type-ahead and full keyboard; animated menu that flips up when space runs out.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog & Sheet
items.description: Modal dialog, alert dialog and sheet in one: default, soft, glass and neo surfaces in six tones; center, top, start/end/left/right and draggable bottom sheets, fullscreen, and a phone override to fullscreen or sheet; scale, slide, blur, fade or morph-from-trigger entrances; async confirm with spinner and inline error, type-to-confirm, nested dialogs that step back, focus trap and restore, and scroll lock without layout shift.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Dark, light, tone, glass and neo tooltips with sizes, shapes, shadows and an optional arrow; twelve placements that flip and shift at the screen edge, scale, fade, slide or spring entrances, rich title + keyboard-shortcut content, delay groups that open instantly after the first, follow-cursor for charts and touch long-press.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored popover with an arrow in default, soft, glass, neo and inverted surfaces, tones, sizes, radii and shadows; side and align that flip and shift to stay on screen, match-trigger-width, scale, fade, slide or spring entrances, header, close button and footer slots, and modal (focus trapped) or non-modal (Tab flows back to the page) behavior, shown as a date filter, share menu, switcher and inline note form.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu button and right-click context menu with default, glass, neo, inverted and flat surfaces, soft, solid, bar or outline highlights, tones, sizes, shapes and shadows; icons, descriptions, badges and live keyboard shortcuts, checkbox items, radio groups, labelled groups, destructive items and nested sub-menus with hover intent and a safe triangle; scale, fade, slide or stagger entrances, type-ahead and full APG keyboard, portaled and flipped to stay on screen.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Autocomplete combobox (ARIA 1.2) with outline, filled, ghost, underline, pill and neo fields, tones, sizes and shadows; local ranked matching or debounced async search with abort, cache, loading, empty and error-with-retry states, every matched word highlighted, groups, avatars, single or multi-select chips, an “Add …” create row and automatic virtualization for 10,000+ rows, in a portaled list that flips above the field.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date picker and calendar with no date library: single, range (two months side by side) and multiple modes, presets, time inputs, min/max, disabled weekdays, booked days, ISO week numbers, month/year quick switch, typed dates parsed in the locale's order via Intl with the locale's first weekday, popover or inline, six field variants, tones, solid/soft/ring selection, day shapes, sizes and slide, fade or scale month animations with APG grid keyboard.

items.name: multi-step-form
items.title: Multi-step Form
items.description: Wizard with numbered, progress-bar or vertical step headers, sync and async per-step validation that blocks Continue and focuses the first invalid field, optional steps with Skip, an auto review step with Edit links, async submit with loading, error retry and success, draft persistence, direction-aware slide or fade transitions and screen-reader step announcements, in card, outline, plain, glass and neo shells with tones and sizes.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Numeric spinbutton with split, end or stacked steppers, press-and-hold acceleration, min/max/step and large steps, Intl currency, percent and unit formatting over a raw value, arrow, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End and focused-wheel stepping, slide or pop step feedback and an invalid state, in the six input variants with tones, sizes, shapes and shadows.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star, heart, circle, bolt, diamond or custom-icon rating in solid, soft, outline, glow and neo styles: half steps, hover preview, clear, animated clip fill with pop or wave, value, count and word labels, read-only exact averages, RTL fill and arrow flipping, with radiogroup or slider semantics.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Single (radiogroup) or multiple (aria-pressed) toggle buttons in outline, soft, solid, segmented, neo and glass styles with a sliding, fading or popping active marker, text or icon items, tones, sizes, shapes, shadows, attached or spaced, vertical, full width, disabled items and roving arrow-key focus that flips in RTL.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Lined, striped, bordered, card-row and minimal tables with tones, three densities, shadows and corner shapes, tint, accent-bar or lift hover, row state tones and selection, sortable headers with aria-sort, sticky header, caption, footer totals, skeleton and empty states, fade or stagger entrances, and rows that stack into labelled cards on small containers.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid
items.description: Virtualized data grid for 100k+ rows with typed columns (number, currency, percent, date, boolean, badge, avatar, actions) formatted by Intl, multi-sort, per-column filters and global search, resize, drag reorder, pin, hide, Shift-range selection with a bulk action bar, inline editing with sync or async validation, spreadsheet keyboard navigation, expandable rows, footer aggregates, CSV and real .xlsx export, loading, empty and error states, server mode with pagination, RTL and tones, densities and variants.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat message
items.description: User, assistant and system messages with avatars, grouping, a hover actions row (copy, good/bad, retry, edit), markdown-ish rendering of lists, quotes and fenced code into CodeBlocks, and a blinking caret while the answer streams.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming text
items.description: Reveals an answer token by token at a steady speed with a cursor that blinks while waiting for more, stop and resume, word or character mode, and smooth catch-up when uneven SSE chunks arrive; reduced motion shows sentence chunks.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool call
items.description: Collapsible card for an agent's tool call: name and arguments in the header, a status that morphs from spinner to drawn check or error, a live duration while running, and argument and output panes inside.

items.name: reasoning-block
items.title: Reasoning block
items.description: "Thinking 8.7s" disclosure with a live tenths timer, a shimmering label while the model reasons, the current step previewed under the header and the full step list plus notes folded inside.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: Model dropdown grouped by provider with icon slots, speed and quality meters that grow in, context window and price per million tokens, a gliding highlight and full keyboard support with type-ahead.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat composer
items.description: Prompt input with an auto-growing textarea, attachment chips from picker, paste or drop, a slash-command menu, model and mode selectors, a token ring against the context limit, Enter or Cmd+Enter to send and a Stop button while streaming.

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Inline numbered source chips that open a spring hover card with title, domain, snippet and date, a CitedText helper that turns [1] markers into chips, and a sources list whose row lights up when its chip is hovered.

items.name: agent-plan
items.title: Agent plan
items.description: Live checklist of an agent's plan: pending, active with a pulsing halo, drawn check, error and skipped states, nested substeps that fold away when done, and a spring progress bar with a step count.

items.name: token-meter
items.title: Token meter
items.description: Context window usage bar whose segments (system, history, tools, response) spring to new widths, with rolling numbers, a legend, and amber then rose tones near and over the limit.

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: Breathing voice-assistant orb that swells with a level prop through a spring: idle breathing, listening rings, speaking light that churns faster, and a spinning thinking arc, all in CSS on theme colors.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: Diff view
items.description: Unified or split diff computed from before and after text, with old/new gutters, syntax colors, changed-character highlights inside replaced lines, and Accept or Reject per hunk that collapses the discarded lines.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Syntax-colored code from a built-in tokenizer or your own tokens, with theme-derived colors, line numbers, highlighted lines, a file tab, copy with a drawn check, a wrap toggle and a staggered line entrance.

items.name: suggestion-chips
items.title: Suggestion chips
items.description: Starter prompts that stagger in on springs, lift on hover and fill the composer on click, as pills, cards with hints or a scrolling row with faded edges; swapping the set replays the entrance.

items.name: thread-list
items.title: Thread list
items.description: Conversation sidebar with search highlighting, pinned and date groups, a selection that glides between rows, hover actions on desktop and swipe-to-reveal on touch, inline rename, delete and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: eval-score
items.title: Eval score
items.description: Evaluation score with a rolling number, a pass, borderline or fail badge that pops in against a threshold, a spring-filled bar and a criteria breakdown with per-criterion thresholds, as card, inline row or badge.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing indicator
items.description: Three dots waving in turn with an "Aiko is typing" sentence for one or several names, as a chat bubble, inline or dots only, mounting and leaving on a spring; reduced motion keeps the dots still.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Area chart that draws its line in on view, morphs between 1W / 1M / 1Y ranges, and rolls its headline value as a hairline and tooltip follow the pointer or the arrow keys.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Multi-series lines that draw in staggered, a legend that toggles series while the scale refits, a crosshair that reads every series at once, and a dashed forecast segment behind a divider.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Grouped, stacked or horizontal bars that grow from the baseline on view and morph when data changes, with a gliding hover band, legend toggles, value labels and 2px surface gaps between segments.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Donut or pie whose slices sweep in clockwise, re-share the ring when a legend item is toggled, push out on hover and roll the center total to the slice under the pointer.

items.name: radial-progress
items.title: Radial progress
items.description: Activity-style concentric goal rings that fill from 12 o'clock on view, spring to new values, dim the others when one is pointed at, and roll the center percentage.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Calendar (GitHub-style) or matrix heatmap on one hue with cells that pop in column by column, a tooltip, arrow-key navigation that scrolls the calendar along, and a Less–More scale.

items.name: funnel-chart
items.title: Funnel chart
items.description: Funnel whose stage bars grow open one after another on an ordinal ramp, with drop-off chips between stages, conversion from the first stage beside each value, and arrow-key rows.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: Semi-circular gauge with Core-tone bands whose needle springs to the value with a small overshoot (or an arc that fills), a rolling readout and a band label pill, exposed as a meter.

items.name: bump-chart
items.title: Bump chart
items.description: Rank-over-time lines that draw in with popping dots and names at the line ends; hovering or arrowing through periods and neighbours highlights one item and reads its change.

items.name: treemap
items.title: Treemap
items.description: Squarified treemap whose tinted tiles fade in largest first and spring to a new layout when values change, with labels only where they fit, a tooltip and arrow-key tiles.

items.name: timeline-chart
items.title: Timeline chart
items.description: Mini Gantt whose bars grow from their start date on view, with progress fills, milestones, group headers, day / week / month ticks, a today marker and arrow-key rows.

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall chart
items.description: Running totals as floating bars that step in one after another in success and danger tones, with neutral total bars, connectors, signed value labels and a tooltip with the running total.

items.name: kpi-trend
items.title: KPI trend
items.description: KPI tile family: the number rolls in on view and on every change (NumberFlow), the delta badge pops and pulses, the sparkline draws itself (SparklineDraw), and a group lines tiles up with hairline dividers.

items.name: chart-legend
items.title: Chart legend
items.description: Shared interactive legend: aria-pressed toggle buttons with popping square, dot, line or dashed swatches, hidden-state strike-through, optional values and a hover channel that highlights a series in its chart.

items.name: agent
items.title: goodui agent pack
items.description: goodui rules for Claude Code (skill), Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Windsurf: which component to use, how to install it, theming, motion, RTL and accessibility rules.
